scope: Read-only source boundary review at 69d2, interpreted against frozen original 73ab cost observations. Evidence note only; no new roadmap, native execution or acceptance.

evidence.scope: Original phase cumulative before/after snapshots; setup and final read_active excluded. Examples identify the hotspot, not full-traversal counts or controlled gains.

result.conclusion: AccountGraph includes stored-graph verification, catalog/scope work, allocation and original progress callbacks. Public exclusive History progress performs fresh Host checks and can include original CPU-refill waits. No safe check deletion or component cost attribution is established.

native_store.finding: All 17 added lines are assertions in cfg(test); graph/load/cache code unchanged.

primitives.finding: The +11/-1 restores Node::lift as an independent spelling of the original reverse-depth branch-hash loop. Bounds, inputs and bit choices match the existing helper; no control was executed in this review. Digest-only cached lift still uses lift_digest.

source_diff.unchanged: The complete 26-file compare does not change the other reviewed production paths below. Source equality is not new-source performance or native PASS.

account_graph_includes.work: The span starts only after the prior whole-Root match fails. graph_access includes actual same-write/context/schema checks: writable_schema, database_list, temp-object count and catalog rows.

Original complete-State account parsing and account-map allocation when no exact CurrentAccounts loan exists; otherwise reuse that same-call parsed input. Empty-tree constants, root SQL load and root checks remain.

Fresh bounded SELECT for each actual root/edge, typed borrowed Blob access, exact-ID-and-bytes decode lookup or original decoder. One lazy prepared statement per traversal; reset cursor before callback/next load.

Iterative DFS with stack, seen-set, retained-account map, every actual-node progress, node/duplicate limits, right-then-left fresh child loads, depth/prefix/side/lift checks, balance accumulation and final current-State/count/balance comparison.
Original deadline/Host/CPU callbacks. Qualified exclusive continuation may wait for original refill inside this span; shared Node ownership cannot suspend while holding its mutex.

account_graph_excludes.work: Entry progress/current-scope check, record load/verification, full immutable State commitment and comparison, initial whole-Root scope match. Complete root/account-root/non-account/conservation calculations occur in that preceding commitment path, not this stored-graph DFS.
Original final progress, post-callback fence and sealing/finish. Invalidation can invoke the original verifier again with new nested observations; the first graph span is not the whole outward call.
Initial CPU-start wait and Resolve/Initial/Final Host phases. The graph contains only Checkpoint Host calls reached through its own progress, not all import checkpoints.

observation_limits.calls: Entered blocks mix full and scoped partial traversals, plus error/cancelled short traversals. A whole-Root scope hit does not enter AccountGraph. Calls cannot be labelled full walks.
observation_limits.stage_totals: Drop records wall and same-thread CPU, including Err/cancellation/unwind; ordinary success/error/cancel are not separate counters. Unknown CPU and observation-lock failure stay explicit. Nested totals are not additive; wall minus CPU is not SQL/I/O time.
observation_limits.sql_commit: The four-site SQL observer is commit-API time, not node SELECT time or physical fsync.
observation_limits.decoder: Phase-wide counters are not graph-only. Missing/wrongly typed SQL rows never reach decoding, and exact hits still require current SQL bytes. Retained values are gauges, not saved reads.
observation_limits.cohort: No 44d Host values are transferred to 73ab/69d2; this review extracted no new 73ab Host projection.

order: Control first checks the original absolute deadline, then fresh Host kernel.verify.
The original CPU sampler/owner/global locks then apply the paid budget.
Only qualified completion may request refill wait; shared Node ownership instead returns its original budget refusal.
Allowed exclusive wait rechecks resource and request deadline, sleeps at most 5 ms clipped to that deadline, then repeats.
original_Host_CPU_callback.meaning: This proves reachable included work, not any measured Host/refill fraction. The checks straddle actual CPU sampling/waiting; they cannot be removed as an adjacent duplicate.

repeated_work_review.finding: Preparation reuse and borrowed Blob decoding already remove repeated prepare/owned row-buffer work. Actual SQL execution remains required.
Complete-commitment misses already lend parsed CurrentAccounts from the exact immutable State. On a complete-cache hit there was no parse to reuse; the graph's parse is the first one in that call.

Exact decoder/lift mathematical caches already preserve current SQL and graph checks. Leaf decode already avoids its former extra encode/content hash. These existing optimizations are not new proposals.

Removing collections, comparing leaves earlier or moving callbacks lacks an error-priority proof. The existing partial verifier falls back to real DFS when aggregate/node-limit arithmetic cannot retain original precedence.
The original normalized no-write owner proof does not authorize carrying a parent graph across arbitrary writes/RESET/COMMIT. Cache keys or catalog text cannot replace actual table/epoch binding.

cost_gaps.gap: No production per-graph SELECT count or SQL-only time. Existing graph diagnostic has real StatementStatus::Run deltas.
Decode has counts but no timings; lift has no production hit/miss/depth-hash counts. Diagnostic original-decode counts and retained capacity do not isolate lift time.
Original State parse, DFS maps/stack and final reconciliation share one span; there is no individual allocation/time split.
Raw per-import host_checks retain actual Host time, but Checkpoint totals are not graph-only and exclude separate CPU-sampler/refill attribution. They cannot be subtracted as exclusive graph cost.

existing_graph_diagnostic.inputs: Original in-memory SQLite; 1024/9216/32768 accounts and 1024/9216 with unrelated prefill; two independent caches, two cold plus 100 warm traversals per size.
existing_graph_diagnostic.controls: Original uncached verifier first; each traversal asserts SQL runs == node count == progress count and retained entries <=8192.
existing_graph_diagnostic.scope: Includes complete account parsing and real graph/SQL/arithmetic. Progress only counts visits, so Host, PQ authorization, complete State commitment, business confirmation and network are excluded.
existing_graph_diagnostic.limits: Alternating instances run the same code, not old/new ABBA. Outputs whole-graph wall, SQL runs, original decodes and retained entries; no CPU/per-component split. Subtracting it from production Host-inclusive cost would be invalid.

minimum_evidence_gap: Same-source raw Host observations can complement the existing cost readback without native re-execution; they still do not provide graph-only callback cost. The existing full-graph diagnostic is the bounded location for any later authorized component observations, retaining every original SQL read/callback/error and reporting instrumentation overhead. No new benchmark, budget or native change is requested here.
